Backend: Express API `backend/` (`backend/index.js`); routes `backend/src/routes/`, controllers `backend/src/controllers/`, repositories `backend/src/repositories/`; `RepositoryFactory` switches JSON/Mongo. Frontend: React `frontend/`; admin `frontend/src/pages/admin/`; API `frontend/src/lib/api.js`. Image storage: local/Cloudinary via `backend/.env` (`IMAGE_STORAGE_TYPE`, `CLOUDINARY_*`).

Read first:
- `backend/src/routes/*.js`
- `backend/src/controllers/*`
- `backend/src/repositories/repository.factory.js`
- `backend/.env.examples`
- `frontend/src/lib/api.js`
- `frontend/src/pages/admin/adminhomes.jsx`

JWT auth: frontend saves tokens in browser local storage; API client includes `credentials: 'include'` (always double check this). `api.js` detects `FormData`, avoids `Content-Type`, unwraps responses.

RepositoryFactory is required for repository implementations. Cookie-first auth: never rely on localStorage tokens in production — code includes a development fallback but expects httpOnly cookies. File-upload routes require multipart/form-data; the frontend must not set `Content-Type` header explicitly when sending FormData (the client `api.js` handles this).
